assets.usage: 首启剧情、品牌欢迎与消息空状态
assets.prompt: Draw Gugu, the canonical original mascot for the Chinese travel-English app 咕游记. Gugu is a tiny migratory songbird, explicitly not an owl: round teardrop body, sky-blue head and wings, cream belly, coral beak and short scarf, warm-yellow crossbody travel satchel, tiny swept feather tuft, large friendly dark eyes. Full-body three-quarter pose, one wing waving hello, open cheerful beak, clean compact silhouette and generous padding. 2.5D premium sticker illustration with crisp deep-navy outline, subtle soft highlight and almost no shadow, readable at 64 pt. Place the isolated bird on a perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background. No scenery, text, watermark, checkerboard, gradients, background texture, cast shadow, reflection, green, owl features, graduation cap, or resemblance to an existing education mascot.
assets.notes: Canonical identity anchor for all later poses; chroma key removed with soft matte and despill.

assets.prompt: Create a polished square iOS app icon for 咕游记 using the canonical Gugu mascot reference.
